data.name: Carbon Plant
data.description: Carbon Plant is an Isle of Man-based, FSA-registered carbon credit exchange that uses NFT digital certificates to authenticate ownership of carbon contracts and offers forward contracts and structured/securitised products. It connects corporate buyers and investors to carbon projects rather than physically removing CO2 itself, functioning as marketplace/exchange infrastructure within the broader carbon ecosystem.
